determinism: No randomness beyond fixed-seed PCG64 bits; sources are hash-checked cached lossless FLAC; resampling is scipy.signal.resample_poly; `verify` rebuilds and compares every output hash.
loop_rule: The app plays the reference WAV as an endless loop and the runner demands WAV samples == raw-video loop samples (frames * 48000 / fps, whole samples). Pair the 60 s variant with 60 s native fixtures and speech-v1-20s with 20 s fixtures; no padding, trimming or tiling is done, and other lengths have no speech reference.

level_definitions.active-RMS-v1: mean power of non-overlapping 20 ms frames within 30 dB of the loudest frame (dBFS, 48 kHz)
level_definitions.step peak: sample peak of the faded excerpt in dBFS
level_definitions.silence: digital zero (guards) or -65 dBFS RMS pink room tone

segments.snr_definition: foreground active-RMS-v1 level minus whole-segment RMS of the added noise/babble
